findings.title: Remove overwritten rollback-test snapshots
findings.why_it_matters: The initial Codex and Claude registration snapshots are immediately overwritten at lines 758-759 before any assertion reads them. Retaining dead setup makes the already long lifecycle test harder to scan and misleadingly suggests the interrupted-snapshot scenarios validate registrations.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete the assignments to old_codex_registration and old_claude_registration at lines 724-725; retain the later snapshots immediately before the failure scenario that asserts them.
evidence: old_codex_registration and old_claude_registration are assigned at lines 724-725.
Neither variable is read before both are reassigned at lines 758-759.
The only subsequent assertions use the later values at lines 769-770.
